title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Gustavus Adolphus College
description: A conservative map of verifiably late food stops in Saint Peter and the nearest larger cluster in Mankato, with access limits stated plainly.

cards.title: Downtown Pizza Until Midnight
cards.subtitle: Saint Peter carryout and delivery
cards.notes: Check the live store page before ordering, then choose carryout or confirm that delivery reaches your address; listed hours can change.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Saint Peter pizza counter whose official location page currently lists service until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page identifies the restaurant at 103 S Minnesota Avenue in St Peter and lists it as open until 12:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 103 S Minnesota Avenue | Domino's in St Peter
cards.access_notes: Food requires purchase. Confirm current carryout or delivery availability on the location page before leaving campus.

cards.title: A Friday or Saturday Take-and-Bake Run
cards.subtitle: Pickup until 9 p.m. on two nights
cards.notes: Order before the posted 9 p.m. Friday or Saturday close, and plan for access to an oven—the store sells uncooked take-and-bake pizza.
cards.short_summary: A south-side Saint Peter pickup option that stays open an hour later on Friday and Saturday than on other listed days.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Murphy’s official location page lists the St. Peter store at 1226 South MN Avenue open until 9:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Papa Murphy's Pizza Takeout Restaurant St. Peter, MN
cards.access_notes: This is take-and-bake food, not a late dine-in stop. The cited page lists the latest closing time only on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: The Madison Avenue Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: Mankato service into the early morning
cards.notes: Treat this as a planned drive from Saint Peter: confirm the live drive-thru hours, designate a rested driver, and do not assume dine-in remains open.
cards.short_summary: One of the nearest first-party-documented options for food well after Saint Peter’s earlier-closing businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists drive-thru service at 1819 Madison Avenue until 2:00 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and Sunday, and 3:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Mankato, MN — 1819 Madison Avenue
cards.access_notes: This Mankato destination requires transportation from Gustavus. The late hours cited are specifically for the drive-thru, not guaranteed indoor seating.

cards.title: The St. Andrews Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: A second late Mankato endpoint
cards.notes: Use the exact St. Andrews address when navigating, verify that the drive-thru is accepting orders, and budget for the round trip from campus.
cards.short_summary: A distinct east-Mankato location with official drive-thru hours extending beyond midnight throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists drive-thru service at 145 St. Andrews Drive until 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurant Near Me in Mankato, MN — 145 St. Andrews Dr
cards.access_notes: Transportation from Gustavus is necessary. The cited late availability applies to the drive-thru; indoor hours are narrower.

cards.title: A Midnight Madison Avenue Stop
cards.subtitle: Restaurant and drive-thru hours match most nights
cards.notes: Check the day before starting the Saint Peter–Mankato drive: Sunday closes earlier, while the official page lists midnight Monday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Mankato fast-food stop with first-party hours through midnight on six nights and 11 p.m. Sunday.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official page lists both restaurant and drive-thru hours at 1545 Madison Avenue until midnight Monday–Saturday and 11:00 p.m. Sunday.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 1545 Madison Avenue in Mankato, MN
cards.access_notes: This is a drive from campus. Purchases are required, and Sunday has an earlier listed closing time than Monday–Saturday.

cards.title: A Weekend Drive-Thru Until Midnight
cards.subtitle: Late access differs from lobby access
cards.notes: Go on Friday or Saturday for the latest listed window, and use the drive-thru—the official page closes the lobby two hours earlier.
cards.short_summary: A Mankato stop where first-party hours clearly separate the 10 p.m. lobby close from later drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official page lists the 1921 Adams Street drive-thru until midnight Friday and Saturday, 11:00 p.m. Monday–Thursday, and 11:00 p.m. Sunday.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Mankato, MN at 1921 Adams St | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: The late window is drive-thru only; the lobby is listed until 10 p.m. Transportation from Gustavus and a purchase are required.

cards.title: A Sit-Down Option on Friday or Saturday
cards.subtitle: Mankato dining until 11 p.m.
cards.notes: Save this for Friday or Saturday, verify the live listing before driving, and arrive with enough time to order before the 11 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A full-service Mankato restaurant whose official schedule runs one hour later on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Perkins’ official location page lists the Mankato restaurant at 1790 Madison Avenue open until 11:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday and 10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.
cards.source_title: Perkins at 1790 Madison Ave Mankato, MN
cards.access_notes: The 11 p.m. closing time applies only Friday and Saturday. This destination requires transportation and a food purchase.

warnings: Only seven non-excluded destinations met the requested evidence standard. The board is incomplete rather than padded with stale listings, bars, inferred hours, or additional branches lacking direct store-hour pages.
Saint Peter’s defensible late-night inventory is exceptionally thin after applying excluded_subjects; five cards therefore identify Mankato destinations that require a planned drive from campus.
Coordinates are null because no verified coordinate source was established during research; destination-specific Google Maps search URLs are supplied without inventing coordinates.
Papa Murphy’s closes at 9 p.m. on its latest nights and is included as an evening take-and-bake run, not as an after-midnight destination.
